snippet.title: Memelis' RPG～Gacha, Saint, Dangerous Dungeon～｜Trailer
snippet.description:
It is an RPG about the protagonist "Memelis," who is deep in debt because she spent everything she had on card lottery in mobile games. 
She embarks on an adventure with her best friend "Tina" to find the treasure hidden in the depths of dungeons.

Developer: @natu5505
